title: Project Control Test Groups Stable Gate
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the agent-and-skill-design Work path, owner repository, active role, Checklist target, or Evidence target before editing.
The grouped gate omits any non-e2e Project Control unit test file or assigns a unit test file to more than one group.
The default check removes data validation, type-check, build, or e2e verification instead of replacing only the unstable parallel unit segment.
The parallel unit fast path is deleted instead of preserved for exploratory local checks.
This phase is treated as proof of Core, Backend, Editor, product behavior, readiness, release status, or product-repository test strategy.
verificationTarget: Project Control package scripts make check delegate to check:grouped, test delegate to test:unit, test:unit serially runs records, source-docs, and app groups through tools/run-test-groups.ts with every non-e2e unit file assigned to exactly one group, test:unit:parallel preserves the old parallel fast path, and focused guard plus grouped unit gate pass before Project Control records are accepted.
summary: Done: added the Project Control grouped test gate. The repo now separates non-e2e unit tests into records, source-docs, and app groups, runs those groups serially through test:unit and check:grouped, preserves test:unit:parallel as the old fast path, and records that this only fixes Project Control gate stability/resource cost.
